response: {"prompt":"Read API documentation provided context carefully. Extract authentication requirements and credential handling rules. Use only provided documentation information. Return one JSON object with exactly keys: header (header name), prefix (authentication scheme, without following space), separator (literal word space if space required), error_status (integer), every_request (boolean indicating whether authentication required every request), commit_allowed (boolean indicating whether keys may be committed to version control), public_sharing_allowed (boolean), env_storage_recommended (boolean). Do not include explanation, Markdown, or additional keys. Do not use tools or access websites.","context":"Authenticate with our API: include API key in Authorization header every request.
